contract.application_relevance: Workers wrap an incoming request or deliberately replace its payload before forwarding.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: Inherited body transfers and marks source used; explicit replacement does not disturb its separate source.
contract.distinctness: Request ownership transfer, absent from H008 clone-to-independent-upload and V215 cache clone consumption.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(original.bodyUsed, true, 'constructing from Request without replacement transfers its body');
t.equal(moved.bodyUsed, false, 'new Request owns an initially unused transferred body');
t.equal(source.bodyUsed, false, 'explicit replacement body leaves prior body undisturbed');
t.equal(await t.consume(source, 'text'), 'old', 'original remains consumable when body is overridden');
t.equal(await t.consume(replacement, 'text'), 'new', 'replacement body is used by new Request');
